source: The Supabase Auth (GoTrue) server, MIT, that a hosted Supabase project runs behind /auth/v1. A fleet database whose accounts lived in a Supabase project's auth schema is served by this same server beside it (`stado database auth place`), so its users, sessions and tokens keep working. The release is the newest published at https://github.com/supabase/auth/releases when adopted; each archive's sha256 is the digest GitHub's release record states for it (`gh release view <tag> --repo supabase/auth --json assets`), since the publisher puts no checksum list beside its archives. A newer release is adopted by changing it here.
